final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status) SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(avg_remaining) / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS remaining_ratio FROM event_averages GROUP BY status
